source.text: לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ עַֽל־שׁוֹשַׁנִּ֬ים לְדָוִֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: For the director, on Shoshannim. Of David.

en.L: For the director: on shoshannim. Of David.
en.B: For the music director. On shoshannim. Of David.
en.R: For the leader of the music. To the tune "Lilies". By David.

fr.L: Au chef de chœur : sur shoshannim. De David.
fr.B: Au chef de chœur. Sur shoshannim. De David.
fr.R: Pour le chef des musiciens. Sur l’air « Les lis ». De David.

sw.L: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya: kwa shoshanimu. Ya Daudi.
sw.B: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya. Kwa shoshanimu. Ya Daudi.
sw.R: Kwa kiongozi wa waimbaji. Kwa sauti ya "Maua ya Yungiyungi". Ya Daudi.

es.L: Al director del coro: sobre shoshannim. De David.
es.B: Al director del coro. Sobre shoshannim. De David.
es.R: Para el director de la música. Con la melodía «Lirios». De David.

vi.L: Cho người chỉ huy [ban nhạc]: theo Sô-sa-nim. Của Đa-vít.
vi.B: Cho nhạc trưởng. Theo Sô-sa-nim. Của Đa-vít.
vi.R: Cho người hướng dẫn ban nhạc. Theo điệu "Hoa huệ". Của Đa-vít.

ko.L: 지휘자를 위하여. 소산님에 맞추어. 다윗의 [시].
ko.B: 음악 지휘자를 위하여. 소산님에 맞추어. 다윗의 시.
ko.R: 찬양 인도자를 위해. "백합화" 곡조에 맞추어. 다윗이 지은 노래.

decisions.choice: The title is verse 1
decisions.reason: The title is part of the Hebrew text and is counted as verse 1, so the verse numbers here are one higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: the director: the one who leads the music
decisions.reason: As in 4:1, probably the leader of the temple music.

decisions.choice: on shoshannim: "on lilies"
alternatives: to the tune of a song called Lilies
decisions.reason: As in 45:1, the word means lilies. It may name a tune, or an instrument; the musical sense is no longer known.

decisions.choice: a psalm the New Testament often quotes
decisions.reason: After Psalm 22, this is the psalm the New Testament quotes most often. Its innocent sufferer, hated without cause and given vinegar to drink, is read there of Jesus (John 2:17; 15:25; 19:28-29; Romans 15:3), and its curses of the enemies are applied to those who rejected him (Acts 1:20; Romans 11:9-10). In the psalm itself the speaker is a human sufferer who also confesses his own folly (verse 6).

decisions.choice: To the tune "Lilies"
decisions.reason: Readable gives one likely sense of the term (m3).

decisions.choice: "Au chef de chœur" (Literal, Balanced); "Pour le chef des musiciens" (Readable), for the psalm titles of this block
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word names the one who led the temple music (meaning decision m2). French says it with a plain modern phrase at each level, as the English does; the same words are used in every title of Psalms 69-83.

decisions.choice: "sur shoshannim" kept as a name (Literal, Balanced); "Sur l'air « Les lis »" (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in the English: the word means "lilies" and is probably the name of a tune (meaning decision m3). Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew word; Readable says what it probably is.

decisions.choice: "Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya" (L, B) and "Kwa kiongozi wa waimbaji" (R) for the title word lamnatseach, through Psalms 69-83
alternatives: "Kwa mkuu wa waimbaji" at every level
decisions.reason: The word names the one who led the temple music. "Kiongozi wa kwaya" is the everyday Swahili for a choir leader; Readable says "leader of the singers", as the English Readable says "leader of the music".

decisions.choice: "shoshanimu" kept as a name at Literal and Balanced; "Maua ya Yungiyungi" (lilies) as the tune at Readable
decisions.reason: The English keeps the Hebrew word at Literal and Balanced and names the tune "Lilies" at Readable; Swahili does the same, with the Swahili word for lilies. What the word meant in the music is no longer known.

decisions.choice: Al director del coro (L, B); Para el director de la música (R); shoshannim (L, B); Con la melodía «Lirios» (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew lamnatseach is a direction to the one who leads the temple music: Literal and Balanced say "Al director del coro", Readable "Para el director de la música", the same in every psalm. Shoshannim means "lilies" and is probably the name of a tune; Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew word, as the English does, and Readable gives the meaning as a tune name, which is a guess.

decisions.choice: "Cho người chỉ huy [ban nhạc]" (L), "Cho nhạc trưởng" (B), "Cho người hướng dẫn ban nhạc" (R)
decisions.reason: The director line in the words of the published Psalm 139:1, used for every psalm of this block.

decisions.choice: "theo Sô-sa-nim" (L, B), "Theo điệu \"Hoa huệ\"" (R)
alternatives: "theo điệu Hoa huệ" at every level
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew word as a name, as the English does; Readable says what it probably means, a tune called "Lilies", as the English Readable does (see the meaning decision).

decisions.choice: The director line is "지휘자를 위하여" (L), "음악 지휘자를 위하여" (B), "찬양 인도자를 위해" (R), as the published Psalm 139:1, for every psalm of Psalms 69-83
decisions.reason: One wording for the director line keeps the psalm titles of this block alike, and matches the psalms already published.

decisions.choice: "소산님에 맞추어" (L, B), "\"백합화\" 곡조에 맞추어" (R); "다윗의 [시]" (L), "다윗의 시" (B), "다윗이 지은 노래" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew word as a name, as the English does; Readable gives its likely sense, a tune called "Lilies", as the English Readable does. Korean cannot leave "of David" without a noun, so Literal supplies "[시]" in brackets and Balanced says "시", the way Korean titles psalms; Readable follows the published titles ("다윗이 지은 노래").

source.text: הוֹשִׁיעֵ֥נִי אֱלֹהִ֑ים כִּ֤י בָ֖אוּ מַ֣יִם עַד־נָֽפֶשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: Save me, God, for waters have come up to [the] neck.

en.L: Save me, God, \q for [the] waters have come up to [my] neck.
en.B: Rescue me, God, \q for the water has risen to my throat.
en.R: Save me, God! \q The water is up to my neck.

fr.L: Sauve-moi, ô Dieu, \q car les eaux sont montées jusqu’à [ma] gorge.
fr.B: Délivre-moi, ô Dieu, \q car l’eau m’arrive à la gorge.
fr.R: Sauve-moi, Dieu ! \q L’eau m’arrive jusqu’au cou.

sw.L: Uniokoe, Ee Mungu, \q kwa maana maji yamefika mpaka [shingoni] mwangu.
sw.B: Ee Mungu, uniokoe, \q kwa maana maji yamepanda mpaka kooni mwangu.
sw.R: Mungu, niokoe! \q Maji yamefika shingoni mwangu.

es.L: Sálvame, oh Dios, \q porque las aguas han subido hasta [mi] cuello.
es.B: Rescátame, oh Dios, \q porque el agua me ha llegado a la garganta.
es.R: ¡Sálvame, Dios! \q El agua me llega al cuello.

vi.L: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, xin cứu tôi, \q vì nước đã dâng lên đến cổ [tôi].
vi.B: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, xin giải cứu tôi, \q vì nước đã dâng lên tận cổ họng tôi.
vi.R: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, xin cứu tôi! \q Nước đã ngập đến cổ tôi rồi.

ko.L: 하나님, 저를 구원하여 주십시오. \q 물이 [제] 목까지 차올랐습니다.
ko.B: 하나님, 저를 건져 주십시오. \q 물이 제 목구멍까지 차올랐습니다.
ko.R: 하나님, 저를 구해 주십시오! \q 물이 목까지 차올랐습니다.

decisions.choice: neck: the throat
decisions.reason: The word is nefesh, which can mean the throat or neck, the place of breathing; so also in Jonah 2. The water is about to close over him.

decisions.choice: waters: overwhelming trouble
decisions.reason: Deep water and mud are pictures of deadly danger (18:17; 40:3; 124:4-5). The picture runs through verses 2-3 and 15-16.

decisions.choice: God is addressed with "tu" at every level, and pronouns for him carry the deity_pronoun setting ("toi|Toi", "ton|Ton")
decisions.reason: French prays to God with "tu", as the psalms of this translation do throughout. The capitalised forms are the reader's alternative, as in English.

decisions.choice: "shingoni" (L, R) and "kooni" (B) for nefesh as the neck or throat, not "nafsi"
decisions.reason: Here nefesh is the throat, the place of breathing, as the meaning decision says. Swahili "nafsi" would read as "soul", so every level names the neck or throat.

decisions.choice: "Lạy Đức Chúa Trời" first, then the request
alternatives: "xin cứu tôi, lạy Đức Chúa Trời" in the Hebrew order
decisions.reason: Vietnamese calls on God with "Lạy" and puts the address at the start of a prayer. "Lạy" is a word the grammar of prayer requires, so Literal does not bracket it (as Psalm 139:1). The singer says "tôi" and speaks to God as "Ngài" through the psalm, as in Psalm 23.

decisions.choice: The psalm is a prayer to God in 합쇼체; the singer is "저/제", and God is called "하나님" or addressed by title, "주님"; there are no deity_pronoun spans in Korean
decisions.reason: Style guide section 7a (speech levels in prayer) and the published Psalms 23 and 139. Hangul has no capitals, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change; respect is carried by 주님, 께서 and -시-. Verses that speak about God rather than to him (31-37) return to the plain written style with "나". This holds for Psalms 69-83.

source.text: טָבַ֤עְתִּי׀בִּיוֵ֣ן מְ֭צוּלָה וְאֵ֣ין מָעֳמָ֑ד בָּ֥אתִי בְמַעֲמַקֵּי־מַ֝֗יִם וְשִׁבֹּ֥לֶת שְׁטָפָֽתְנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: I have sunk in [the] mire of [the] depth, and there is no standing; I have come into [the] depths of water, and a flood has swept over me.

en.L: I have sunk in [the] mire of the deep, and there is no foothold; \q I have come into [the] depths of water, and a flood has swept over me.
en.B: I am sinking in deep mud with nothing to stand on; \q I have gone down into deep water, and the current is carrying me away.
en.R: I am sinking in deep mud. There is nothing solid to stand on. \q I am in deep water, and the flood is washing over me.

fr.L: Je me suis enfoncé dans la boue de l’abîme, et il n’y a pas d’appui ; \q je suis entré dans les profondeurs des eaux, et le courant m’a submergé.
fr.B: Je m’enfonce dans une boue profonde, sans rien pour me tenir debout ; \q je suis descendu dans les eaux profondes, et le courant m’emporte.
fr.R: Je m’enfonce dans la boue profonde. Il n’y a rien de solide sous mes pieds. \q Je suis dans l’eau profonde, et le flot passe par-dessus moi.

sw.L: Nimezama katika matope ya kilindi, wala hapana mahali pa kusimama; \q nimeingia katika vilindi vya maji, na mafuriko yamenigharikisha.
sw.B: Ninazama katika matope mazito, bila kitu cha kusimamia; \q nimeshuka katika maji ya kina, na mkondo unanichukua.
sw.R: Ninazama katika matope mengi. Hakuna mahali pagumu pa kusimama. \q Niko katika maji marefu, na mafuriko yananifunika.

es.L: Me he hundido en [el] fango de lo profundo, y no hay dónde apoyar el pie; \q he entrado en [las] profundidades de [las] aguas, y la corriente me ha cubierto.
es.B: Me hundo en un lodo profundo sin nada en que apoyarme; \q he bajado a aguas hondas, y la corriente me arrastra.
es.R: Me estoy hundiendo en barro profundo. No hay nada firme donde pararme. \q Estoy en aguas hondas, y la inundación me pasa por encima.

vi.L: Tôi đã lún sâu trong bùn lầy của vực sâu, và không có chỗ đứng; \q tôi đã sa vào [những] chỗ nước sâu, và dòng lũ đã cuốn ngập tôi.
vi.B: Tôi đang lún xuống bùn sâu, không có chỗ nào để đứng; \q tôi đã chìm xuống nước sâu, và dòng nước đang cuốn tôi đi.
vi.R: Tôi đang lún xuống bùn sâu. Không có chỗ nào vững để đứng. \q Tôi ở trong nước sâu, và cơn lũ đang tràn qua tôi.

ko.L: 제가 깊은 수렁에 빠졌는데, 디딜 곳이 없습니다. \q 제가 깊은 물속에 들어왔는데, 큰물이 저를 휩쓸었습니다.
ko.B: 제가 깊은 진흙 속으로 빠져 들어가는데, 발 디딜 곳이 없습니다. \q 깊은 물속으로 내려가니, 물살이 저를 휩쓸어 갑니다.
ko.R: 저는 깊은 진흙 속으로 빠져 들어가고 있습니다. 단단히 디딜 곳이 없습니다. \q 저는 깊은 물속에 있고, 홍수가 저를 덮칩니다.

decisions.choice: mire: deep, sucking mud
decisions.reason: The word (yawen) is the mud at the bottom of a pit or swamp (40:3).

decisions.choice: flood: a rushing current
decisions.reason: The word (shibbolet) is a stream in flood, strong enough to carry a person off.

source.text: יָגַ֣עְתִּי בְקָרְאִי֮ נִחַ֪ר גְּר֫וֹנִ֥י כָּל֥וּ עֵינַ֑י מְ֝יַחֵ֗ל לֵאלֹהָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: I am weary with my crying; my throat is parched; my eyes have failed, waiting for my God.

en.L: I am weary with my crying; my throat is parched; \q my eyes have failed, \q waiting for my God.
en.B: I am exhausted from calling out; my throat is burning dry. \q My eyes have grown dim \q from watching for my God.
en.R: I have cried for help until I am tired. My throat is dry and sore. \q I have watched for my God so long that my eyes are worn out.

fr.L: Je suis épuisé à force de crier ; ma gorge est desséchée ; \q mes yeux se sont consumés, \q à attendre mon Dieu.
fr.B: Je suis épuisé d’appeler au secours ; ma gorge me brûle. \q Mes yeux se sont usés \q à guetter mon Dieu.
fr.R: J’ai crié au secours jusqu’à en être fatigué. Ma gorge est sèche et me fait mal. \q J’ai attendu mon Dieu si longtemps que mes yeux n’en peuvent plus.

sw.L: Nimechoka kwa kulia kwangu; koo langu limekauka; \q macho yangu yamedhoofika, \q nikimngojea Mungu wangu.
sw.B: Nimechoka kwa kuita; koo langu linawaka kwa ukavu. \q Macho yangu yamefifia \q kwa kumtazamia Mungu wangu.
sw.R: Nimelia nikiomba msaada mpaka nimechoka. Koo langu limekauka na linauma. \q Nimemngoja Mungu wangu muda mrefu mpaka macho yangu yamechoka.

es.L: Estoy cansado de mi clamar; mi garganta está reseca; \q mis ojos han desfallecido, \q esperando a mi Dios.
es.B: Estoy agotado de tanto gritar; me arde la garganta seca. \q Se me han nublado los ojos \q de tanto buscar con la mirada a mi Dios.
es.R: He pedido ayuda a gritos hasta cansarme. Tengo la garganta seca y adolorida. \q He esperado a mi Dios tanto tiempo que ya no me dan los ojos.

vi.L: Tôi mệt lả vì kêu la; cổ họng tôi khô rát; \q mắt tôi đã mờ đi, \q vì trông đợi Đức Chúa Trời của tôi.
vi.B: Tôi kiệt sức vì kêu cầu; cổ họng tôi khô bỏng. \q Mắt tôi đã mờ đi \q vì trông chờ Đức Chúa Trời của tôi.
vi.R: Tôi kêu cứu đến mệt lả. Cổ họng tôi khô và đau rát. \q Tôi trông chờ Đức Chúa Trời của tôi lâu đến nỗi mắt tôi mỏi mòn.

ko.L: 제가 부르짖느라 지쳤고, 제 목은 말라 탔습니다. \q 제 눈이 흐려졌습니다. \q 제 하나님을 기다리느라.
ko.B: 부르짖다가 저는 기진했고, 목은 타는 듯이 말랐습니다. \q 제 눈이 흐려졌습니다. \q 제 하나님을 기다리다 지쳐서입니다.
ko.R: 도와 달라고 부르짖다가 저는 지쳐 버렸습니다. 목이 마르고 아픕니다. \q 제 하나님을 너무 오래 기다려서 눈이 다 짓물렀습니다.

decisions.choice: my eyes have failed: worn out with watching
decisions.reason: Eyes that "fail" are tired and dim from looking long for help that has not come (119:82; Lamentations 4:17).

decisions.choice: parched: burning, dried up
decisions.reason: The verb (charar) is to be scorched; his throat is raw from calling.

source.text: רַבּ֤וּ׀מִשַּׂעֲר֣וֹת רֹאשִׁי֮ שֹׂנְאַ֪י חִ֫נָּ֥ם עָצְמ֣וּ מַ֭צְמִיתַי אֹיְבַ֣י שֶׁ֑קֶר אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־גָ֝זַ֗לְתִּי אָ֣ז אָשִֽׁיב׃

records.literal_gloss: More than [the] hairs of my head are those who hate me without cause; mighty are those who destroy me, my enemies [of] falsehood; what I did not steal, then I must restore.

en.L: More than the hairs of my head are those who hate me without cause; \q mighty are those who would destroy me, my enemies [who speak] falsehood; \q what I did not steal, I must then restore.
en.B: There are more people hating me for no reason than hairs on my head; \q strong are the ones who seek my ruin, my enemies with their lies. \q Am I to repay what I never took?
en.R: More people hate me than there are hairs on my head, and they have no reason to. \q My enemies are strong and tell lies about me. They want to destroy me. \q They make me pay back things I never stole.

fr.L: Plus nombreux que les cheveux de ma tête sont ceux qui me haïssent sans raison ; \q puissants sont ceux qui veulent me détruire, mes ennemis [qui disent] le mensonge ; \q ce que je n’ai pas volé, il me faut alors le rendre.
fr.B: Ceux qui me haïssent sans raison sont plus nombreux que les cheveux de ma tête ; \q ils sont forts, ceux qui cherchent ma perte, mes ennemis menteurs. \q Dois-je rendre ce que je n’ai jamais pris ?
fr.R: Il y a plus de gens qui me détestent que de cheveux sur ma tête, et ils n’ont aucune raison. \q Mes ennemis sont forts et mentent sur moi. Ils veulent me détruire. \q Ils m’obligent à rendre des choses que je n’ai jamais volées.

sw.L: Ni wengi kuliko nywele za kichwa changu \q wale wanichukiao bila sababu; \q wana nguvu wale wanaotaka kuniangamiza, adui zangu [wa] uongo; \q kile ambacho sikukiiba, ndipo nitakirudisha.
sw.B: Watu wanaonichukia bila sababu ni wengi kuliko nywele za kichwa changu; \q wana nguvu wale wanaotafuta kuniangamiza, adui zangu waongo. \q Je, nilipe kile ambacho sikuchukua kamwe?
sw.R: Watu wanaonichukia ni wengi kuliko nywele za kichwa changu, nao hawana sababu yoyote. \q Adui zangu wana nguvu, nao husema uongo juu yangu. Wanataka kuniangamiza. \q Wananilazimisha kurudisha vitu ambavyo sikuiba kamwe.

es.L: Más que los cabellos de mi cabeza son los que me odian sin causa; \q poderosos son los que quieren destruirme, mis enemigos [que hablan] mentira; \q lo que no robé, entonces he de devolverlo.
es.B: Son más los que me odian sin razón que los cabellos de mi cabeza; \q fuertes son los que buscan mi ruina, mis enemigos mentirosos. \q ¿Tendré que devolver lo que nunca tomé?
es.R: Hay más gente que me odia que cabellos en mi cabeza, y no tienen razón para hacerlo. \q Mis enemigos son fuertes y dicen mentiras de mí. Quieren destruirme. \q Me obligan a devolver cosas que nunca robé.

vi.L: Nhiều hơn tóc trên đầu tôi là những kẻ ghét tôi vô cớ; \q mạnh thay những kẻ muốn hủy diệt tôi, là những kẻ thù [nói] dối của tôi; \q điều tôi không cướp, bấy giờ tôi phải trả lại.
vi.B: Người ghét tôi vô cớ còn nhiều hơn tóc trên đầu tôi; \q những kẻ tìm cách hủy hoại tôi thật mạnh thế, là những kẻ thù dối trá của tôi. \q Lẽ nào tôi phải trả lại điều tôi chưa hề lấy?
vi.R: Người ghét tôi còn nhiều hơn tóc trên đầu tôi, mà họ chẳng có lý do gì. \q Kẻ thù tôi rất mạnh và nói dối về tôi. Chúng muốn hủy diệt tôi. \q Chúng bắt tôi phải đền những thứ tôi chưa hề lấy cắp.

ko.L: 까닭 없이 저를 미워하는 자들이 제 머리털보다 많습니다. \q 저를 멸하려는 자들, 거짓[을 말하는] 제 원수들이 강합니다. \q 제가 빼앗지 않은 것을 그때 제가 돌려주어야 합니다.
ko.B: 이유 없이 저를 미워하는 사람이 제 머리카락보다 많습니다. \q 저를 망하게 하려는 자들, 거짓말하는 제 원수들이 강합니다. \q 제가 빼앗지도 않은 것을 물어내야 합니다.
ko.R: 저를 미워하는 사람이 제 머리카락보다 많은데, 그들에게는 아무 이유도 없습니다. \q 제 원수들은 힘이 세고 저에 대해 거짓말을 합니다. 저를 없애려고 합니다. \q 제가 훔치지도 않은 것을 갚으라고 합니다.

decisions.choice: John 15:25: "They hated me without cause"
decisions.reason: Jesus says that the word written in their law is fulfilled in him: "They hated me without a cause." The same words are found in 35:19.

decisions.choice: my enemies of falsehood: enemies who lie
decisions.reason: The word (sheqer) means falsehood. They are enemies on false grounds, who accuse him with lies.

decisions.choice: what I did not steal, I must restore
alternatives: must I now restore what I did not steal?
decisions.reason: He is made to pay back what he never took, perhaps as a proverb for being punished though innocent. It may also be read as a bitter question.

source.text: אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים אַתָּ֣ה יָ֭דַעְתָּ לְאִוַּלְתִּ֑י וְ֝אַשְׁמוֹתַ֗י מִמְּךָ֥ לֹא־נִכְחָֽדוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: God, you know my folly, and my guilty deeds from you are not hidden.

en.L: God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} know my folly, \q and my guilty deeds are not hidden from {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.B: God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} know my foolishness; \q none of my guilt is hidden from {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.R: God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} know the foolish things I have done. \q You can see all my sins.

fr.L: Ô Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} connais ma folie, \q et mes fautes ne sont pas cachées pour {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.B: Ô Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} connais ma sottise ; \q aucune de mes fautes ne {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}est cachée.
fr.R: Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} connais les bêtises que j’ai faites. \q Tu vois tous mes péchés.

sw.L: Ee Mungu, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unaujua upumbavu wangu, \q na makosa yangu hayakufichika kwako.
sw.B: Ee Mungu, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unajua upumbavu wangu; \q hakuna hatia yangu yoyote iliyofichika kwako.
sw.R: Mungu, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unayajua mambo ya kipumbavu niliyofanya. \q Unaziona dhambi zangu zote.

es.L: Dios, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} conoces mi necedad, \q y mis culpas no están ocultas de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
es.B: Dios, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} conoces mi insensatez; \q ninguna de mis culpas se {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} oculta.
es.R: Dios, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} sabes las tonterías que he hecho. \q Tú ves todos mis pecados.

vi.L: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} biết sự dại dột của tôi, \q và những tội lỗi của tôi không giấu khỏi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} biết sự ngu dại của tôi; \q không một tội lỗi nào của tôi giấu được {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} biết những điều dại dột tôi đã làm. \q Ngài thấy hết mọi tội lỗi của tôi.

ko.L: 하나님, 주님께서는 저의 어리석음을 아십니다. \q 저의 죄들이 주님께 감추어져 있지 않습니다.
ko.B: 하나님, 주님께서는 제가 얼마나 어리석은지 아십니다. \q 저의 허물은 하나도 주님 앞에 숨겨지지 않습니다.
ko.R: 하나님, 주님께서는 제가 저지른 어리석은 일들을 아십니다. \q 주님께서는 저의 죄를 다 보십니다.

decisions.choice: folly and guilt: he does not claim to be sinless
decisions.reason: The psalmist is hated without cause (verse 5), yet he admits his own foolishness and wrongs before God, who sees them all. He asks for help on the basis of God's love, not his own innocence (verse 14).

decisions.choice: guilty deeds: wrongs that bring guilt
decisions.reason: The word ('ashmah) is guilt, here in the plural for the wrongs that caused it.

decisions.choice: tú
decisions.reason: The psalmist speaks to God with "tú", the ordinary second person of prayer in Spanish, close and direct as the Hebrew is; "usted" would sound distant. The pronoun takes the deity pronoun setting, except at the start of a sentence, where it is capitalised either way.

source.text: אַל־יֵ֘בֹ֤שׁוּ בִ֨י׀קֹוֶיךָ֮ אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֗ה צְבָ֫א֥וֹת אַל־יִכָּ֣לְמוּ בִ֣י מְבַקְשֶׁ֑יךָ אֱ֝לֹהֵ֗י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: Let not those who wait for you be ashamed in me, Lord YHWH of hosts; let not those who seek you be humiliated in me, God of Israel.

en.L: Let not those who wait for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} be ashamed because of me, my Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of hosts; \q let not those who seek {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} be humiliated because of me, \q God of Israel.
en.B: May no one who waits for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} be shamed through me, Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of Armies; \q may no one who seeks {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} be humiliated through me, \q God of Israel.
en.R: Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of Armies, people who trust {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are waiting for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} help. Do not let them be embarrassed because of me. \q God of Israel, do not let those who look to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} be shamed because of me.

fr.L: Que ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}espèrent ne soient pas couverts de honte à cause de moi, Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées ; \q que ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} cherchent ne soient pas humiliés à cause de moi, \q Dieu d’Israël.
fr.B: Que personne de ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}attendent ne soit déshonoré par ma faute, Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées ; \q que personne de ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} cherchent ne soit humilié par ma faute, \q Dieu d’Israël.
fr.R: Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées, ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} font confiance attendent {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} aide. Ne les laisse pas avoir honte à cause de moi. \q Dieu d’Israël, ne laisse pas ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} cherchent être humiliés à cause de moi.

sw.L: Wasiaibike kwa sababu yangu wale wakungojeao, Bwana wangu {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi; \q wasifedheheke kwa sababu yangu wale wakutafutao, \q Ee Mungu wa Israeli.
sw.B: Mtu yeyote akungojeaye asiaibishwe kwa ajili yangu, Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi; \q mtu yeyote akutafutaye asifedheheshwe kwa ajili yangu, \q Ee Mungu wa Israeli.
sw.R: Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, watu wanaokutumainia wanangojea msaada {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}. Usiache waaibike kwa sababu yangu. \q Mungu wa Israeli, usiache wale wanaokutafuta waone haya kwa sababu yangu.

es.L: Que no sean avergonzados por causa de mí los que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} esperan, mi Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos; \q que no sean humillados por causa de mí los que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} buscan, \q oh Dios de Israel.
es.B: Que nadie que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} espera quede en vergüenza a causa de mí, Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos; \q que nadie que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} busca sea humillado a causa de mí, \q Dios de Israel.
es.R: Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, la gente que confía en {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} espera {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ayuda. No permitas que pasen vergüenza por causa mía. \q Dios de Israel, no permitas que los que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} buscan queden en ridículo por causa mía.

vi.L: Xin đừng để những người trông đợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phải hổ thẹn vì tôi, lạy Chúa [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân; \q xin đừng để những người tìm kiếm {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phải nhục nhã vì tôi, \q lạy Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Lạy Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, xin đừng để ai trông đợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phải xấu hổ vì tôi; \q xin đừng để ai tìm kiếm {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phải nhục nhã vì tôi, \q lạy Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Lạy Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, những người tin cậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang trông đợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giúp đỡ. Xin đừng để họ phải xấu hổ vì tôi. \q Lạy Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, xin đừng để những người hướng về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phải nhục nhã vì tôi.

ko.L: 주님을 기다리는 자들이 저 때문에 부끄러움을 당하지 않게 하십시오, 나의 주 만군의 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}여. \q 주님을 찾는 자들이 저 때문에 수치를 당하지 않게 하십시오, \q 이스라엘의 하나님이여.
ko.B: 만군의 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}여, 주님을 기다리는 사람이 저 때문에 부끄러움을 당하지 않게 하여 주십시오. \q 주님을 찾는 사람이 저 때문에 욕을 보지 않게 하여 주십시오, \q 이스라엘의 하나님.
ko.R: 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}여, 주님을 믿는 사람들이 주님의 도움을 기다리고 있습니다. 저 때문에 그들이 창피를 당하지 않게 해 주십시오. \q 이스라엘의 하나님, 주님을 바라보는 사람들이 저 때문에 부끄러움을 당하지 않게 해 주십시오.

decisions.choice: ashamed because of me: let down by my fall
decisions.reason: If God abandons him, those who trust God will be ashamed, as if their hope were empty. His rescue matters for all the faithful.

decisions.choice: Lord GOD of hosts: 'Adonai YHWH tseba'ot
decisions.reason: Here the title "Lord" stands with the name and "of hosts". As where "the Lord" stands with the name elsewhere, the name is written GOD.

decisions.choice: the LORD of Armies
decisions.reason: The title (YHWH tseba'ot) names the LORD as commander of the armies of heaven, his angels and the stars (1 Kings 22:19; Isaiah 40:26), and of Israel's army (1 Samuel 17:45). Literal keeps the older "hosts"; Balanced and Readable say "Armies", as in Isaiah.

decisions.choice: are waiting for your help
decisions.reason: Readable says what they wait for.

decisions.choice: "Seigneur DIEU" for Adonai YHWH, with "Yahvé" as the reader's alternative for the name; "des armées" at every level; "le SEIGNEUR" for YHWH alone, for this block
decisions.reason: As in the Pentateuch: capitals mark the divine name, as the English "LORD" and "GOD" do, and "l'Éternel", the Segond tradition, is the form a reviewer may prefer. "Des armées" is the ordinary French for tseba'ot and serves at every level, so French needs no change where the English moves from "hosts" to "Armies".

decisions.choice: "Bwana MUNGU wa majeshi" for Adonai YHWH tseba'ot, with the name in capitals as the setting span; "majeshi" (armies, hosts) at every level
decisions.reason: Where "Lord" stands with the name, the name is written MUNGU, as in the Pentateuch. "Majeshi" is the ordinary Swahili word for armies and also covers the heavenly hosts, so one word serves the English "hosts" and "Armies".

decisions.choice: mi Señor DIOS de los ejércitos (L); Señor DIOS de los Ejércitos (B, R)
decisions.reason: When the Hebrew has Adonai ("Lord") before the name YHWH, Spanish writes "Señor DIOS", with the name in capitals and the reader setting for it, as in the Pentateuch. Tseba'ot is "ejércitos", the armies God commands: lowercase at Literal, capitalised as part of the title at Balanced and Readable, as in Psalm 46.

decisions.choice: "Chúa là CHÚA Vạn Quân" for Adonai YHWH of hosts, with "là" bracketed at Literal
decisions.reason: Vietnamese says "Chúa" (Lord) for Adonai and "CHÚA" for the divine name, so the two side by side would read "Chúa CHÚA". Joining them with "là" ("the Lord, who is the LORD") keeps both words, and the divine_name setting still switches the second to "Gia-vê". "vạn quân" (of the countless armies) serves for "of hosts" at Literal and "of Armies" at Balanced and Readable: it is the plain Vietnamese way to say the LORD commands armies, heavenly and earthly.

decisions.choice: Adonai YHWH is "주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}": "주" for Adonai, and the divine name, where the English has "GOD", as a divine_name span whose default is "하나님"; "of hosts" is "만군의" (L, B), "하늘의 군대를 거느리신" (R)
decisions.reason: The default form of the name, "주", would stand beside "주" for Adonai and read "Lord Lord"; the English writes "GOD" for the same reason. "하나님" as the default keeps both words apart, and the setting still gives "야훼". Readable says what "hosts" means, as the English Readable does with "Armies". This holds wherever Adonai YHWH stands in Psalms 69-83.

source.text: כִּֽי־עָ֭לֶיךָ נָשָׂ֣אתִי חֶרְפָּ֑ה כִּסְּתָ֖ה כְלִמָּ֣ה פָנָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: For on account of you I have borne reproach; humiliation has covered my face.

en.L: For on account of {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} I have borne reproach; \q humiliation has covered my face.
en.B: Because of {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} I have carried scorn; \q humiliation covers my face.
en.R: I am insulted because I belong to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. \q My face burns with shame.

fr.L: Car c’est à cause de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} que j’ai porté l’insulte ; \q l’humiliation a couvert mon visage.
fr.B: C’est pour {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} que je supporte le mépris ; \q la honte couvre mon visage.
fr.R: On m’insulte parce que je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}appartiens. \q Mon visage brûle de honte.

sw.L: Kwa maana kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} nimestahimili aibu; \q fedheha imeufunika uso wangu.
sw.B: Kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} nimebeba dharau; \q fedheha inaufunika uso wangu.
sw.R: Ninatukanwa kwa sababu mimi ni {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}. \q Uso wangu unawaka kwa aibu.

es.L: Porque por causa de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} he soportado afrenta; \q la humillación ha cubierto mi rostro.
es.B: Por {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} he cargado con el desprecio; \q la humillación me cubre la cara.
es.R: Me insultan porque {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} pertenezco. \q La vergüenza me quema la cara.

vi.L: Vì cớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tôi đã chịu sỉ nhục; \q sự nhục nhã đã che phủ mặt tôi.
vi.B: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà tôi phải mang lấy sự khinh miệt; \q nỗi nhục phủ đầy mặt tôi.
vi.R: Tôi bị sỉ nhục vì tôi thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Mặt tôi nóng bừng vì xấu hổ.

ko.L: 참으로 주님 때문에 제가 모욕을 짊어졌고, \q 수치가 제 얼굴을 덮었습니다.
ko.B: 주님 때문에 제가 비웃음을 받았고, \q 수치가 제 얼굴을 덮습니다.
ko.R: 제가 주님께 속한 사람이라서 모욕을 당합니다. \q 부끄러워서 얼굴이 화끈거립니다.

decisions.choice: for your sake: suffering for God
decisions.reason: His suffering is not only for his own wrongs: he is mocked because of his loyalty to God (verse 10; Jeremiah 15:15).

decisions.choice: shame has covered my face
decisions.reason: Shame is pictured as a covering over the face (44:16).

decisions.choice: because I belong to you
decisions.reason: Readable says how his suffering is "for God's sake" (m1).

source.text: מ֭וּזָרהָיִ֣יתִי לְאֶחָ֑י וְ֝נָכְרִ֗י לִבְנֵ֥י אִמִּֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Estranged I have become to my brothers and a foreigner to [the] sons of my mother.

en.L: Estranged I have become to my brothers, \q and a foreigner to the sons of my mother.
en.B: My own brothers treat me as a stranger; \q to my mother's sons I am an outsider.
en.R: Even my brothers act as if they do not know me. \q My own family treats me like a foreigner.

fr.L: Je suis devenu un étranger pour mes frères, \q et un inconnu pour les fils de ma mère.
fr.B: Mes propres frères me traitent comme un étranger ; \q pour les fils de ma mère, je suis quelqu’un du dehors.
fr.R: Même mes frères font comme s’ils ne me connaissaient pas. \q Ma propre famille me traite comme un étranger.

sw.L: Nimekuwa mgeni kwa ndugu zangu, \q na mtu wa kigeni kwa wana wa mama yangu.
sw.B: Ndugu zangu wenyewe hunitendea kama mgeni; \q kwa wana wa mama yangu mimi ni mtu wa nje.
sw.R: Hata ndugu zangu wanajifanya kana kwamba hawanijui. \q Jamaa yangu wenyewe wananitendea kama mgeni.

es.L: Extraño he llegado a ser para mis hermanos, \q y extranjero para los hijos de mi madre.
es.B: Mis propios hermanos me tratan como a un extraño; \q para los hijos de mi madre soy un forastero.
es.R: Hasta mis hermanos actúan como si no me conocieran. \q Mi propia familia me trata como a un extranjero.

vi.L: Tôi đã trở nên xa lạ với anh em tôi, \q và [thành] người ngoại quốc với các con trai của mẹ tôi.
vi.B: Chính anh em tôi đối xử với tôi như người lạ; \q với các con của mẹ tôi, tôi là người dưng.
vi.R: Ngay cả anh em tôi cũng làm như không quen biết tôi. \q Chính gia đình tôi đối xử với tôi như người nước ngoài.

ko.L: 제가 제 형제들에게 낯선 사람이 되었고, \q 제 어머니의 아들들에게 이방인[이 되었습니다].
ko.B: 제 형제들마저 저를 낯선 사람처럼 대하고, \q 제 어머니의 아들들에게 저는 남이 되었습니다.
ko.R: 제 형제들조차 저를 모르는 사람처럼 대합니다. \q 제 가족이 저를 외국 사람처럼 대합니다.

decisions.choice: the sons of my mother: my closest family
decisions.reason: Sons of the same mother were the closest of brothers in a household with more than one wife. Even they have turned away (Job 19:13-15).

decisions.choice: rejected by his own
decisions.reason: John 7:5 says that Jesus' brothers did not believe in him.

source.text: כִּֽי־קִנְאַ֣ת בֵּיתְךָ֣ אֲכָלָ֑תְנִי וְחֶרְפּ֥וֹת ח֝וֹרְפֶ֗יךָ נָפְל֥וּ עָלָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: For zeal for your house has consumed me, and [the] reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen on me.

en.L: For zeal for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} house has consumed me, \q and the reproaches of those who reproach {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have fallen on me.
en.B: Passion for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} house burns me up, \q and the taunts aimed at {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have landed on me.
en.R: I care so much about {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} house that it eats me up inside. \q When people insult {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, the insults fall on me.

fr.L: Car le zèle pour {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} maison m’a dévoré, \q et les insultes de ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}insultent sont tombées sur moi.
fr.B: Le zèle pour {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} maison me consume, \q et les outrages qu’on {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} lance retombent sur moi.
fr.R: J’aime tant {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} maison que cela me ronge de l’intérieur. \q Quand on {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}insulte, c’est sur moi que tombent les insultes.

sw.L: Kwa maana wivu kwa ajili ya nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} umenila, \q na matukano ya wale wanaokutukana yameniangukia.
sw.B: Shauku ya nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} inaniteketeza, \q na dhihaka walizokuelekezea zimenipata mimi.
sw.R: Ninaijali nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} sana hata inanila moyoni. \q Watu wanapokutukana, matusi yao yananiangukia mimi.

es.L: Porque el celo por {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} casa me ha consumido, \q y las afrentas de los que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} afrentan han caído sobre mí.
es.B: La pasión por {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} casa me quema por dentro, \q y los insultos dirigidos a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} han caído sobre mí.
es.R: Me importa tanto {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} casa que me consume por dentro. \q Cuando la gente {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} insulta, los insultos caen sobre mí.

vi.L: Vì lòng nhiệt thành đối với nhà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã thiêu nuốt tôi, \q và những lời sỉ nhục của những kẻ sỉ nhục {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đổ trên tôi.
vi.B: Lòng sốt sắng vì nhà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thiêu đốt tôi, \q và những lời chế nhạo nhắm vào {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giáng xuống tôi.
vi.R: Tôi quá lo cho nhà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến nỗi lòng tôi như bị thiêu đốt. \q Khi người ta sỉ nhục {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, những lời sỉ nhục ấy đổ lên tôi.

ko.L: 참으로 주님의 집을 향한 열심이 저를 삼켰고, \q 주님을 모욕하는 자들의 모욕이 제게 떨어졌습니다.
ko.B: 주님의 집을 향한 열정이 저를 불태우고, \q 주님을 향한 조롱이 제게 쏟아졌습니다.
ko.R: 저는 주님의 집을 너무나 아끼기 때문에 속이 다 타 버립니다. \q 사람들이 주님을 모욕하면 그 모욕이 저에게 떨어집니다.

decisions.choice: John 2:17: "Zeal for your house will consume me"
decisions.reason: When Jesus drove the traders out of the temple, his disciples remembered this line (John 2:17).

decisions.choice: Romans 15:3: "The insults of those who insult you fell on me"
decisions.reason: Paul quotes the second half of the verse: Christ did not please himself, but bore the insults aimed at God.

decisions.choice: zeal: burning devotion
decisions.reason: The word (qin'ah) is intense, jealous devotion; here his love for God's house (the temple) that will not let it be dishonored.

source.text: וָאֶבְכֶּ֣ה בַצּ֣וֹם נַפְשִׁ֑י וַתְּהִ֖י לַחֲרָפ֣וֹת לִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And I wept with fasting my soul, and it became reproaches to me.

en.L: And I wept, [humbling] my soul with fasting, \q and it became reproaches to me.
en.B: I wept and went without food, \q and for that they mocked me.
en.R: When I cried and went without food, \q people made fun of me.

fr.L: Et j’ai pleuré, [humiliant] mon âme par le jeûne, \q et cela est devenu pour moi des insultes.
fr.B: J’ai pleuré et je me suis privé de nourriture, \q et pour cela on s’est moqué de moi.
fr.R: Quand j’ai pleuré et que j’ai cessé de manger, \q les gens se sont moqués de moi.

sw.L: Nami nililia, [nikiinyenyekeza] nafsi yangu kwa kufunga, \q nalo likawa matukano kwangu.
sw.B: Nililia na kukaa bila kula, \q nao wakanidhihaki kwa ajili ya hilo.
sw.R: Nilipolia na kukaa bila kula, \q watu walinicheka.

es.L: Y lloré, [humillando] mi alma con ayuno, \q y eso se volvió afrentas para mí.
es.B: Lloré y dejé de comer, \q y por eso se burlaron de mí.
es.R: Cuando lloré y dejé de comer, \q la gente se rió de mí.

vi.L: Và tôi đã khóc, [hạ] linh hồn tôi [xuống] bằng sự kiêng ăn, \q và điều đó đã trở thành những lời sỉ nhục cho tôi.
vi.B: Tôi khóc lóc và kiêng ăn, \q thế mà vì vậy chúng lại chế giễu tôi.
vi.R: Khi tôi khóc và nhịn ăn, \q người ta lại chế giễu tôi.

ko.L: 제가 울며 금식으로 제 영혼을 [낮추었더니], \q 그것이 제게 모욕거리가 되었습니다.
ko.B: 제가 울며 금식하였더니, \q 그 일로 그들이 저를 조롱하였습니다.
ko.R: 제가 울면서 음식을 먹지 않았더니, \q 사람들이 저를 놀렸습니다.

decisions.choice: I wept with fasting my soul: I wept and fasted
alternatives: I humbled my soul with fasting (the ancient Greek translation)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is short: "I wept, in fasting, my soul". It seems to mean he wept and fasted with his whole self. The ancient Greek translation reads "I bowed my soul with fasting", as in 35:13.

decisions.choice: fasting: going without food in grief and prayer
decisions.reason: People fasted to mourn, to repent, or to plead with God (35:13; 2 Samuel 12:16).

decisions.choice: humbling (L)
decisions.reason: Literal supplies the verb that "fasting my soul" implies (m1).

decisions.choice: "[humiliant] mon âme" at Literal, with "âme" for nefesh
alternatives: "mon âme dans le jeûne" with no verb
decisions.reason: French cannot join "my soul" to "fasting" without a verb either, so Literal supplies one in brackets, as the English does. Nefesh is "âme" at Literal (the terms note); Balanced and Readable say plainly that he fasted.

decisions.choice: mi alma
decisions.reason: The Hebrew nefesh is "soul", the living self. Literal keeps "alma", as in the other psalms; Balanced and Readable say only what he did, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "영혼" for nefesh at Literal, with "[낮추었더니]" supplied
decisions.reason: The terms note gives "영혼" for nefesh at Literal; here it stands for the whole self, humbled by fasting, and Balanced and Readable say "금식하였더니" without it, as the English does.

source.text: וָאֶתְּנָ֣ה לְבוּשִׁ֣י שָׂ֑ק וָאֱהִ֖י לָהֶ֣ם לְמָשָֽׁל׃

records.literal_gloss: And I made my clothing sackcloth, and I became to them a byword.

en.L: And I made sackcloth my clothing, \q and I became a byword to them.
en.B: When I put on sackcloth for clothing, \q they made me the butt of their sayings.
en.R: When I wore rough sackcloth to show my sorrow, \q they joked about me.

fr.L: Et j’ai fait du sac mon vêtement, \q et je suis devenu pour eux un sujet de proverbe.
fr.B: Quand j’ai pris un sac pour vêtement, \q ils ont fait de moi la cible de leurs dictons.
fr.R: Quand je me suis habillé d’un sac de toile rude pour montrer mon chagrin, \q ils ont fait des plaisanteries sur moi.

sw.L: Nami nilifanya gunia kuwa vazi langu, \q nikawa kitu cha kusemwa kwao.
sw.B: Nilipovaa gunia kama nguo, \q walinifanya kuwa kichekesho cha misemo yao.
sw.R: Nilipovaa gunia gumu kuonyesha huzuni yangu, \q walinifanyia mzaha.

es.L: E hice de tela de saco mi vestido, \q y llegué a ser un refrán para ellos.
es.B: Cuando me vestí con tela de saco, \q me convirtieron en blanco de sus dichos.
es.R: Cuando me puse ropa áspera de saco para mostrar mi tristeza, \q hicieron chistes de mí.

vi.L: Và tôi đã lấy vải sô làm áo mặc của tôi, \q và tôi đã trở thành câu cửa miệng cho chúng.
vi.B: Khi tôi mặc vải sô làm áo, \q chúng lấy tôi làm đề tài để giễu cợt.
vi.R: Khi tôi mặc áo vải thô để tỏ lòng buồn rầu, \q chúng đem tôi ra làm trò cười.

ko.L: 제가 굵은 베를 제 옷으로 삼았더니, \q 제가 그들에게 웃음거리 말이 되었습니다.
ko.B: 제가 굵은 베옷을 입었더니, \q 그들은 저를 두고 빈정대는 말을 지어냈습니다.
ko.R: 제가 슬퍼하는 마음을 보이려고 거친 베옷을 입었더니, \q 사람들이 저를 두고 농담을 했습니다.

decisions.choice: sackcloth: rough cloth worn in mourning
decisions.reason: Sackcloth, made of goat's hair, was worn in grief and repentance (35:13; Genesis 37:34).

decisions.choice: byword: a saying, a joke
decisions.reason: The word (mashal) is a proverb; here his name has become a saying people use to mock (44:15).

decisions.choice: to show my sorrow
decisions.reason: Readable says why sackcloth was worn.

decisions.choice: tela de saco
decisions.reason: Sackcloth was a rough cloth of goat hair worn in mourning. "Tela de saco" says plainly what it was; "cilicio" now suggests a garment worn to hurt oneself.

source.text: יָשִׂ֣יחוּ בִ֭י יֹ֣שְׁבֵי שָׁ֑עַר וּ֝נְגִינ֗וֹת שׁוֹתֵ֥י שֵׁכָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: They talk about me, those who sit [in the] gate, and [I am the] songs of drinkers of strong drink.

en.L: Those who sit [in the] gate talk about me, \q and [I am the] songs of the drinkers of strong drink.
en.B: The people who sit at the city gate gossip about me, \q and drunkards sing songs mocking me.
en.R: The leaders who sit at the city gate talk about me. \q Drunks make up songs about me.

fr.L: Ceux qui sont assis [à la] porte parlent de moi, \q et [je suis] les chansons des buveurs de boisson forte.
fr.B: Ceux qui siègent à la porte de la ville bavardent sur moi, \q et les ivrognes chantent des chansons pour se moquer de moi.
fr.R: Les chefs assis à la porte de la ville parlent de moi. \q Les ivrognes inventent des chansons sur moi.

sw.L: Wale waketio [langoni] wananizungumza, \q nami [ni] nyimbo za walevi wa kileo.
sw.B: Watu waketio kwenye lango la mji hunisengenya, \q na walevi huimba nyimbo za kunidhihaki.
sw.R: Viongozi waketio kwenye lango la mji wananizungumzia. \q Walevi wanatunga nyimbo juu yangu.

es.L: Hablan de mí los que se sientan [a la] puerta, \q y [soy las] canciones de los bebedores de licor.
es.B: Los que se sientan a la puerta de la ciudad murmuran de mí, \q y los borrachos cantan canciones burlándose de mí.
es.R: Los líderes que se sientan a la puerta de la ciudad hablan de mí. \q Los borrachos inventan canciones sobre mí.

vi.L: Những kẻ ngồi [nơi] cổng [thành] bàn tán về tôi, \q và [tôi là] những bài hát của những kẻ uống rượu mạnh.
vi.B: Những người ngồi nơi cổng thành xì xào về tôi, \q và những kẻ say rượu hát những bài chế nhạo tôi.
vi.R: Các bậc lãnh đạo ngồi nơi cổng thành bàn tán về tôi. \q Những kẻ say rượu đặt bài hát về tôi.

ko.L: 성문에 앉은 자들이 저에 대해 수군거리고, \q [저는] 독주를 마시는 자들의 노래들[이 되었습니다].
ko.B: 성문에 앉은 사람들이 저를 두고 험담하고, \q 술꾼들은 저를 놀리는 노래를 부릅니다.
ko.R: 성문에 앉은 지도자들이 저에 대해 이야기합니다. \q 술 취한 사람들은 저에 대한 노래를 지어 부릅니다.

decisions.choice: those who sit in the gate: the town's leaders
decisions.reason: The open space at the city gate was where elders judged cases and people met (Ruth 4:1-2; Proverbs 31:23). He is mocked by the leading men and by drunkards alike.

decisions.choice: songs: mocking songs
decisions.reason: The word (neginot) is music on strings; here, songs made up to mock him (Lamentations 3:14).

decisions.choice: the leaders
alternatives: those who sit in the gate
decisions.reason: Readable says who sat at the gate (m1).

source.text: וַאֲנִ֤י תְפִלָּתִֽי־לְךָ֨׀יְהוָ֡ה עֵ֤ת רָצ֗וֹן אֱלֹהִ֥ים בְּרָב־חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ עֲ֝נֵ֗נִי בֶּאֱמֶ֥ת יִשְׁעֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: But I, my prayer [is] to you, YHWH, [at a] time of favor; God, in [the] greatness of your loyal love answer me in [the] faithfulness of your salvation.

en.L: But I — my prayer [is] to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, [at a] time of favor; \q God, in the greatness of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love, \q answer me in the faithfulness of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} salvation.
en.B: But as for me, I pray to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, at a time {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will accept; \q God, in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} great loyal love, \q answer me with {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful rescue.
en.R: But I keep praying to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}. Now is the time to show me kindness. \q God, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful love is so great! \q Answer me, because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are faithful to save.

fr.L: Mais moi, ma prière [va] vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, [au] temps de la faveur ; \q ô Dieu, dans la grandeur de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour loyal, \q réponds-moi dans la fidélité de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} salut.
fr.B: Mais moi, je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} prie, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, au temps où {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} accueilles la prière ; \q ô Dieu, dans la grandeur de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle, \q réponds-moi par {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} secours fidèle.
fr.R: Mais moi, je continue à {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} prier, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. C’est maintenant le moment de me montrer {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bonté. \q Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle est si grand ! \q Réponds-moi, car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es fidèle pour sauver.

sw.L: Lakini mimi, maombi yangu [ni] kwako, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, [wakati wa] kibali; \q Ee Mungu, kwa wingi wa upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma, \q unijibu kwa uaminifu wa wokovu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.
sw.B: Lakini mimi, ninakuomba wewe, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wakati utakaoukubali; \q Ee Mungu, kwa upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} mkuu usiokoma, \q unijibu kwa uokoaji {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wa uaminifu.
sw.R: Lakini mimi ninaendelea kukuomba, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Sasa ni wakati wa kunionyesha wema. \q Mungu, upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma ni mkuu sana! \q Unijibu, kwa sababu wewe ni mwaminifu kuokoa.

es.L: Pero yo, mi oración [es] a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, [en un] tiempo de favor; \q oh Dios, en la grandeza de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor leal, \q respóndeme en la fidelidad de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} salvación.
es.B: Pero yo, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, elevo a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} mi oración en un tiempo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} aceptarás; \q oh Dios, por {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} gran amor fiel, \q respóndeme con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} salvación segura.
es.R: Pero yo sigo orando a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Ahora es el momento de ser bueno conmigo. \q Dios, ¡qué grande es {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel! \q Respóndeme, porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres fiel para salvar.

vi.L: Còn tôi, lời cầu nguyện của tôi [dâng lên] {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, [vào] kỳ ân huệ; \q lạy Đức Chúa Trời, theo sự lớn lao của tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q xin đáp lời tôi bằng sự thành tín của sự cứu rỗi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Còn tôi, tôi cầu nguyện cùng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vào lúc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẵn lòng nhậm lời; \q lạy Đức Chúa Trời, vì tình yêu thương thành tín lớn lao của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q xin đáp lời tôi bằng sự giải cứu thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Nhưng tôi vẫn cầu nguyện cùng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Bây giờ là lúc xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tỏ lòng nhân từ với tôi. \q Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thật lớn lao! \q Xin đáp lời tôi, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thành tín giải cứu.

ko.L: 그러나 저는, 제 기도가 주님께 [드려집니다], {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 은혜의 때에. \q 하나님, 주님의 크신 한결같은 사랑으로 \q 주님의 구원의 신실하심으로 제게 응답하여 주십시오.
ko.B: 그러나 저는, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님께서 받아 주실 때에 주님께 기도합니다. \q 하나님, 주님의 크신 한결같은 사랑으로 \q 주님의 신실한 구원으로 제게 응답하여 주십시오.
ko.R: 그래도 저는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 계속 기도합니다. 지금이 저에게 인자를 베푸실 때입니다. \q 하나님, 주님의 변함없는 사랑은 정말 큽니다! \q 주님께서는 신실하게 구원하시니, 제게 응답해 주십시오.

decisions.choice: a time of favor: a time when God is pleased to answer
alternatives: may this be a time of your favor
decisions.reason: The words describe the right moment, when God accepts a prayer and acts (Isaiah 49:8, quoted in 2 Corinthians 6:2). He prays that this will be such a time.

decisions.choice: loyal love: chesed
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is love that keeps faith within a bond: the LORD's committed, dependable kindness to his people. Literal and Balanced say "loyal love".

decisions.choice: the faithfulness of your salvation: your dependable rescue
decisions.reason: God's rescue is sure because he is faithful ('emet) to his promises.

decisions.choice: faithful love
decisions.reason: Readable uses plainer words for chesed (see the meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "amour loyal" (Literal); "amour fidèle" (Balanced, Readable) for hesed, for this block
decisions.reason: Hesed is love that keeps faith with a bond (meaning decision m2). The terms note gives French "amour loyal" at Literal and "amour fidèle" at Balanced and Readable, so the English Balanced "loyal love" becomes "amour fidèle" in French.

decisions.choice: "upendo usiokoma" (love that does not stop) for chesed at every level, through Psalms 69-83; "fadhili" where the English says "kindness"
decisions.reason: The word is love that keeps faith within a bond. "Upendo usiokoma" says both the love and its faithfulness, and serves the English "loyal love" and "faithful love" alike; "fadhili" (favour, kindness) is kept for the places where the English has "kindness".

decisions.choice: God is addressed with the second person singular ("wewe", "-ako") at every level; the deity_pronoun setting can capitalise only free pronouns ("wewe", "wako", "yako"), not the verb prefixes
decisions.reason: Swahili prayer speaks to God as "wewe", as the style guide says. Because most pronouns are inside the verb ("unijibu"), Swahili has fewer setting spans than the English.

decisions.choice: amor leal (L); amor fiel (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew hesed is love that keeps faith with a bond. Literal says "amor leal", Balanced and Readable "amor fiel", the same in every psalm; "misericordia", the older rendering, says pity rather than loyalty.

decisions.choice: "tình yêu thương thành tín" (L, B); "tình thương không hề thay đổi" (R)
decisions.reason: Hesed is love that keeps faith (see the meaning decision). These are the words of the published Psalm 23:6, kept for every use in this block of psalms. Readable says "tỏ lòng nhân từ" (show kindness) where the English Readable says "show me kindness".

decisions.choice: "한결같은 사랑" (L, B), "변함없는 사랑" (R) for chesed, as the published Psalm 23:6 and the terms note; Readable also has "인자를 베푸실" where the English Readable says "show me kindness"
decisions.reason: Chesed is love that keeps faith; one Korean term holds through the Psalter. "인자" is the terms note word for "kindness".

source.text: הַצִּילֵ֣נִי מִ֭טִּיט וְאַל־אֶטְבָּ֑עָה אִנָּצְלָ֥ה מִ֝שֹּֽׂנְאַ֗י וּמִמַּֽעֲמַקֵּי־מָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: Deliver me from [the] mud, and let me not sink; let me be delivered from those who hate me and from [the] depths of water.

en.L: Deliver me from [the] mud, and let me not sink; \q let me be delivered from those who hate me and from [the] depths of water.
en.B: Pull me out of the mud, and do not let me go under; \q let me be snatched away from those who hate me, out of the deep water.
en.R: Pull me out of the mud! Do not let me sink. \q Save me from people who hate me. Get me out of this deep water.

fr.L: Délivre-moi de la boue, et que je ne m’enfonce pas ; \q que je sois délivré de ceux qui me haïssent et des profondeurs des eaux.
fr.B: Tire-moi de la boue, et ne me laisse pas couler ; \q que je sois arraché à ceux qui me haïssent et aux eaux profondes.
fr.R: Tire-moi de la boue ! Ne me laisse pas m’enfoncer. \q Sauve-moi de ceux qui me détestent. Sors-moi de cette eau profonde.

sw.L: Uniokoe na matope, wala nisizame; \q niokolewe na wale wanichukiao na vilindi vya maji.
sw.B: Unitoe katika matope, wala usiniache nizame; \q niponywe kutoka kwa wale wanaonichukia, nitoke katika maji ya kina.
sw.R: Nitoe katika matope! Usiache nizame. \q Niokoe kutoka kwa watu wanaonichukia. Nitoe katika maji haya marefu.

es.L: Líbrame del fango, y que no me hunda; \q que sea yo librado de los que me odian y de [las] profundidades de [las] aguas.
es.B: Sácame del lodo, y no dejes que me hunda; \q que sea arrebatado de los que me odian, fuera de las aguas profundas.
es.R: ¡Sácame del barro! No dejes que me hunda. \q Sálvame de la gente que me odia. Sácame de esta agua profunda.

vi.L: Xin giải cứu tôi khỏi bùn, và đừng để tôi chìm xuống; \q xin cho tôi được giải cứu khỏi những kẻ ghét tôi và khỏi [những] chỗ nước sâu.
vi.B: Xin kéo tôi lên khỏi bùn lầy, đừng để tôi chìm nghỉm; \q xin giật tôi ra khỏi tay những kẻ ghét tôi, ra khỏi vùng nước sâu.
vi.R: Xin kéo tôi ra khỏi bùn! Đừng để tôi chìm xuống. \q Xin cứu tôi khỏi những người ghét tôi. Xin đưa tôi ra khỏi vùng nước sâu này.

ko.L: 진흙에서 저를 건지시고 제가 빠지지 않게 하여 주십시오. \q 저를 미워하는 자들에게서, 그리고 깊은 물에서 제가 건짐을 받게 하여 주십시오.
ko.B: 진흙에서 저를 끌어내 주시고, 가라앉지 않게 하여 주십시오. \q 저를 미워하는 사람들에게서, 깊은 물에서 저를 낚아채 주십시오.
ko.R: 진흙에서 저를 끌어내 주십시오! 가라앉지 않게 해 주십시오. \q 저를 미워하는 사람들에게서 구해 주십시오. 이 깊은 물에서 꺼내 주십시오.

decisions.choice: the mud and the deep water: his enemies
decisions.reason: The pictures of verses 2-3 return, now set beside "those who hate me": the danger he is drowning in is the hatred of his enemies.

decisions.choice: deliver: snatch away
decisions.reason: The verb (natsal) is to pull someone out of danger.

source.text: אַל־תִּשְׁטְפֵ֤נִי׀שִׁבֹּ֣לֶת מַ֭יִם וְאַל־תִּבְלָעֵ֣נִי מְצוּלָ֑ה וְאַל־תֶּאְטַר־עָלַ֖י בְּאֵ֣ר פִּֽיהָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Let not [the] flood of water sweep over me, and let not [the] deep swallow me, and let not [the] pit close its mouth over me.

en.L: Let not the flood of water sweep over me, and let not the deep swallow me, \q and let not the pit close its mouth over me.
en.B: Do not let the flood waters wash over me or the deep gulp me down, \q or the pit shut its mouth on me.
en.R: Do not let the flood wash over me. Do not let the deep water swallow me. \q Do not let the grave close its mouth over me.

fr.L: Que le courant des eaux ne me submerge pas, et que l’abîme ne m’engloutisse pas, \q et que le puits ne referme pas sa bouche sur moi.
fr.B: Ne laisse pas le flot des eaux me recouvrir ni l’abîme m’avaler, \q ni le puits refermer sa bouche sur moi.
fr.R: Ne laisse pas le flot passer sur moi. Ne laisse pas l’eau profonde m’avaler. \q Ne laisse pas la tombe se refermer sur moi.

sw.L: Mafuriko ya maji yasinigharikishe, wala kilindi kisinimeze, \q wala shimo lisifunge kinywa chake juu yangu.
sw.B: Usiache mafuriko ya maji yanifunike, wala kilindi kinimeze, \q wala shimo linifungie kinywa chake.
sw.R: Usiache mafuriko yanifunike. Usiache maji marefu yanimeze. \q Usiache kaburi lifunge kinywa chake juu yangu.

es.L: Que no me cubra la corriente de las aguas, y que no me trague lo profundo, \q y que no cierre el pozo su boca sobre mí.
es.B: No dejes que me cubran las aguas de la inundación ni que me engulla el abismo, \q ni que el pozo cierre su boca sobre mí.
es.R: No dejes que la inundación me pase por encima. No dejes que el agua profunda me trague. \q No dejes que la tumba cierre su boca sobre mí.

vi.L: Xin đừng để dòng nước lũ cuốn ngập tôi, và đừng để vực sâu nuốt tôi, \q và đừng để hố sâu khép miệng nó trên tôi.
vi.B: Xin đừng để nước lũ tràn ngập tôi, hay vực sâu nuốt chửng tôi, \q hay hố sâu ngậm miệng lại trên tôi.
vi.R: Xin đừng để cơn lũ tràn qua tôi. Đừng để nước sâu nuốt mất tôi. \q Đừng để mồ mả khép miệng lại trên tôi.

ko.L: 큰물의 물결이 저를 휩쓸지 않게 하시고, 깊음이 저를 삼키지 않게 하시고, \q 구덩이가 제 위에서 그 입을 닫지 않게 하여 주십시오.
ko.B: 큰물이 저를 덮치거나 깊은 물이 저를 삼키지 않게 하시고, \q 구덩이가 제 위로 입을 다물지 않게 하여 주십시오.
ko.R: 홍수가 저를 덮치지 않게 해 주십시오. 깊은 물이 저를 삼키지 않게 해 주십시오. \q 무덤이 제 위로 입을 다물지 않게 해 주십시오.

decisions.choice: the pit: a well, the grave
decisions.reason: The word (be'er) is a well or a pit; it stands for the grave and the place of the dead (55:24). A pit that closes its mouth leaves no way out.

decisions.choice: the grave
decisions.reason: Readable says what the pit stands for (m1).

source.text: עֲנֵ֣נִי יְ֭הוָה כִּי־ט֣וֹב חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ כְּרֹ֥ב רַ֝חֲמֶ֗יךָ פְּנֵ֣ה אֵלָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Answer me, YHWH, for good [is] your loyal love; according to [the] greatness of your compassions turn to me.

en.L: Answer me, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, for good [is] {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love; \q according to the greatness of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} compassion turn to me.
en.B: Answer me, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, because {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love is good; \q in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} great compassion, turn toward me.
en.R: Answer me, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, because {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful love is so good. \q You are full of kindness, so turn and look at me.

fr.L: Réponds-moi, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, car bon [est] {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour loyal ; \q selon la grandeur de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} compassions tourne-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} vers moi.
fr.B: Réponds-moi, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, car {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle est bon ; \q dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} grande tendresse, tourne-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} vers moi.
fr.R: Réponds-moi, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, car {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle est si bon. \q Tu es plein de tendresse : tourne-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} et regarde-moi.

sw.L: Unijibu, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma [ni] mwema; \q kwa wingi wa huruma {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} unigeukie.
sw.B: Unijibu, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa sababu upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma ni mwema; \q kwa huruma {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} nyingi, unigeukie.
sw.R: Unijibu, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa sababu upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma ni mwema sana. \q Wewe umejaa huruma, basi unigeukie na kunitazama.

es.L: Respóndeme, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, porque bueno [es] {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor leal; \q conforme a la grandeza de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} compasión vuélvete a mí.
es.B: Respóndeme, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel es bueno; \q en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} gran compasión, vuélvete hacia mí.
es.R: Respóndeme, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel es muy bueno. \q Tú estás lleno de bondad; vuélvete y mírame.

vi.L: Xin đáp lời tôi, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] tốt lành; \q theo sự lớn lao của lòng thương xót của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, xin quay lại cùng tôi.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin đáp lời tôi, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thật tốt lành; \q theo lòng thương xót lớn lao của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, xin quay mặt về phía tôi.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin đáp lời tôi, vì tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thật tốt lành. \q Ngài đầy lòng thương xót, xin quay lại nhìn tôi.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제게 응답하여 주십시오. 주님의 한결같은 사랑이 좋기 때문입니다. \q 주님의 크신 긍휼에 따라 저에게로 돌아보아 주십시오.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제게 응답하여 주십시오. 주님의 한결같은 사랑은 선합니다. \q 주님의 크신 긍휼로 저를 돌아보아 주십시오.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제게 응답해 주십시오. 주님의 변함없는 사랑은 정말 좋습니다. \q 주님께서는 불쌍히 여기는 마음이 가득하시니, 저를 돌아보아 주십시오.

decisions.choice: loyal love: chesed
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is love that keeps faith within a bond: the LORD's committed, dependable kindness to his people. Literal and Balanced say "loyal love".

decisions.choice: compassion: tender mercy
decisions.reason: The word (rachamim) is related to the word for womb: the tender love of a mother or father (103:13).

decisions.choice: turn to me: look on me with favor
decisions.reason: As in 25:16, to turn toward someone is to pay attention and help.

decisions.choice: faithful love
decisions.reason: Readable uses plainer words for chesed (see the meaning decision).

source.text: וְאַל־תַּסְתֵּ֣ר פָּ֭נֶיךָ מֵֽעַבְדֶּ֑ךָ כִּֽי־צַר־לִ֝֗י מַהֵ֥ר עֲנֵֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: And do not hide your face from your servant, for I am in distress; quickly answer me.

en.L: And do not hide {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face from {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant, \q for I am in distress; quickly answer me.
en.B: Do not turn away from me, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant; \q I am hard pressed, so be quick to answer me.
en.R: I am {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant. Do not turn away from me. \q I am in trouble, so answer me quickly!

fr.L: Et ne cache pas {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur, \q car je suis dans la détresse ; vite, réponds-moi.
fr.B: Ne {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} détourne pas de moi, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur ; \q je suis dans l’angoisse, alors hâte-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} de me répondre.
fr.R: Je suis {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur. Ne {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} détourne pas de moi. \q Je suis dans le malheur : réponds-moi vite !

sw.L: Wala usimfiche mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, \q kwa maana niko katika dhiki; unijibu upesi.
sw.B: Usinigeuzie mgongo, mimi mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}; \q nimesongwa sana, basi uharakishe kunijibu.
sw.R: Mimi ni mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}. Usinigeuzie mgongo. \q Niko katika taabu, basi unijibu upesi!

es.L: Y no escondas {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rostro de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo, \q porque estoy en angustia; respóndeme pronto.
es.B: No {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} apartes de mí, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo; \q estoy en apuros: date prisa en responderme.
es.R: Soy {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo. No {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} apartes de mí. \q Estoy en problemas, ¡respóndeme pronto!

vi.L: Và xin đừng giấu mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} khỏi đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q vì tôi đang gặp gian nan; xin mau đáp lời tôi.
vi.B: Xin đừng ngoảnh mặt khỏi tôi, là đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q tôi đang bị dồn ép, xin mau đáp lời tôi.
vi.R: Tôi là đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Xin đừng quay mặt khỏi tôi. \q Tôi đang gặp hoạn nạn, xin mau đáp lời tôi!

ko.L: 주님의 얼굴을 주님의 종에게서 숨기지 마십시오. \q 제가 고난 중에 있으니 속히 제게 응답하여 주십시오.
ko.B: 주님의 종인 저를 외면하지 마십시오. \q 제가 궁지에 몰렸으니 어서 응답하여 주십시오.
ko.R: 저는 주님의 종입니다. 저를 외면하지 마십시오. \q 제가 어려움에 빠졌으니 어서 응답해 주십시오!

decisions.choice: hide your face: turn away, refuse to help
decisions.reason: For God to hide his face is to withdraw his presence and favor (13:2; 27:9).

decisions.choice: your servant: one who belongs to God
decisions.reason: The psalmist calls himself God's servant ('eved), one who serves and depends on his master.

decisions.choice: turn away from
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the picture means (m1).

decisions.choice: "ton serviteur" at every level, Literal included
decisions.reason: Here the psalmist calls himself God's servant, one who belongs to God (meaning decision m2), so French says "serviteur" at every level, as this translation does wherever a psalmist speaks of himself so to God.

decisions.choice: "mtumishi wako" (your servant) at every level, Literal included, where the psalmist names himself to God
decisions.reason: The term note gives "mtumwa" (slave) at Literal for 'eved. As the psalmist's humble name for himself before God, "mtumishi wako" is what Swahili prayer says, and "mtumwa" would point to slavery itself, which is not the point here.

decisions.choice: tu siervo
decisions.reason: Elsewhere 'eved is "esclavo" at Literal, but when the psalmist calls himself God's servant the English Literal too says "servant": he speaks of belonging to God and serving him, not of slavery. So "tu siervo" is used at every level, as in the other psalms.

decisions.choice: "đầy tớ của Ngài" (your servant) at every level
alternatives: "nô lệ" at Literal, as for doulos in John
decisions.reason: The psalmist calls himself God's servant, one who belongs to him (see the meaning decision). As the English keeps "servant" at Literal, Vietnamese keeps "đầy tớ" at every level; "nô lệ" would sound like a man in chains, not a worshiper.

decisions.choice: "주님의 종" for the psalmist as God's servant at every level
decisions.reason: "종" is the word for one who belongs to and serves a master (style guide, slave); the psalmist names himself so before God.

source.text: קָרְבָ֣ה אֶל־נַפְשִׁ֣י גְאָלָ֑הּ לְמַ֖עַן אֹיְבַ֣י פְּדֵֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: Draw near to my soul; redeem it; because of my enemies ransom me.

en.L: Draw near to my soul; redeem it; \q because of my enemies ransom me.
en.B: Come close to me and buy me back; \q set me free because of my enemies.
en.R: Come near and save my life. \q Set me free, so that my enemies will not win.

fr.L: Approche-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} de mon âme ; rachète-la ; \q à cause de mes ennemis, libère-moi.
fr.B: Viens près de moi et rachète-moi ; \q délivre-moi, à cause de mes ennemis.
fr.R: Viens près de moi et sauve ma vie. \q Libère-moi, pour que mes ennemis ne gagnent pas.

sw.L: Uikaribie nafsi yangu, uikomboe; \q kwa sababu ya adui zangu unifidie.
sw.B: Uje karibu nami, unikomboe; \q uniweke huru kwa sababu ya adui zangu.
sw.R: Uje karibu uyaokoe maisha yangu. \q Uniweke huru, ili adui zangu wasishinde.

es.L: Acércate a mi alma; redímela; \q por causa de mis enemigos rescátame.
es.B: Ven cerca de mí y rescátame; \q ponme en libertad por causa de mis enemigos.
es.R: Acércate y salva mi vida. \q Ponme en libertad, para que mis enemigos no ganen.

vi.L: Xin đến gần linh hồn tôi; xin cứu chuộc nó; \q vì cớ những kẻ thù tôi, xin chuộc tôi ra.
vi.B: Xin đến gần tôi và chuộc tôi về; \q xin giải thoát tôi vì cớ những kẻ thù tôi.
vi.R: Xin đến gần và cứu mạng sống tôi. \q Xin giải thoát tôi, để kẻ thù tôi không thắng được.

ko.L: 제 영혼에게 가까이 오셔서 그것을 속량하여 주십시오. \q 제 원수들 때문에 저를 대속하여 주십시오.
ko.B: 저에게 가까이 오셔서 저를 되찾아 주십시오. \q 제 원수들이 있으니 저를 풀어 주십시오.
ko.R: 가까이 오셔서 제 목숨을 구해 주십시오. \q 제 원수들이 이기지 못하도록 저를 풀어 주십시오.

decisions.choice: redeem, ransom: buy back and set free
decisions.reason: Both verbs come from family and legal life. To redeem (ga'al) is what a close relative did for a kinsman in debt or slavery (Leviticus 25:25, 48); to ransom (padah) is to pay the price that sets someone free.

decisions.choice: because of my enemies: so they do not triumph
decisions.reason: God's rescue will show the enemies that the one they mocked was not abandoned (verse 7).

decisions.choice: me (B); my life (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "me" or "my life" for nefesh.

decisions.choice: so that my enemies will not win
decisions.reason: Readable says how the enemies are the reason (m2).

source.text: אַתָּ֤ה יָדַ֗עְתָּ חֶרְפָּתִ֣י וּ֭בָשְׁתִּי וּכְלִמָּתִ֑י נֶ֝גְדְּךָ֗ כָּל־צוֹרְרָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: You know my reproach and my shame and my humiliation; before you [are] all my foes.

en.L: You know my reproach and my shame and my humiliation; \q before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} [are] all my foes.
en.B: You know the scorn I bear, my shame and my disgrace; \q every one of my enemies is in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} sight.
en.R: You know how they insult me, shame me and make me look foolish. \q You see all my enemies.

fr.L: Tu connais mon insulte, et ma honte, et mon humiliation ; \q devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} [sont] tous mes adversaires.
fr.B: Tu connais le mépris que je subis, ma honte et mon déshonneur ; \q tous mes ennemis sont sous {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} yeux.
fr.R: Tu sais comment ils m’insultent, me font honte et me rendent ridicule. \q Tu vois tous mes ennemis.

sw.L: Wewe unajua aibu yangu na fedheha yangu na unyonge wangu; \q mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} [wako] watesi wangu wote.
sw.B: Wewe unajua dharau ninayobeba, aibu yangu na fedheha yangu; \q kila mmoja wa adui zangu yuko mbele ya macho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Wewe unajua jinsi wanavyonitukana, wanavyoniaibisha na kunifanya nionekane mjinga. \q Unawaona adui zangu wote.

es.L: Tú conoces mi afrenta y mi vergüenza y mi humillación; \q delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} [están] todos mis adversarios.
es.B: Tú conoces el desprecio que cargo, mi vergüenza y mi deshonra; \q todos mis enemigos están ante {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} ojos.
es.R: Tú sabes cómo me insultan, me avergüenzan y me ponen en ridículo. \q Tú ves a todos mis enemigos.

vi.L: Ngài biết sự sỉ nhục của tôi, sự xấu hổ của tôi và sự nhục nhã của tôi; \q trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] tất cả những kẻ thù địch của tôi.
vi.B: Ngài biết sự khinh miệt tôi phải chịu, nỗi xấu hổ và sự ô nhục của tôi; \q mọi kẻ thù của tôi đều ở trước mắt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Ngài biết chúng sỉ nhục tôi, làm tôi xấu hổ và khiến tôi trông thật ngu dại thế nào. \q Ngài thấy hết mọi kẻ thù của tôi.

ko.L: 주님께서는 저의 모욕과 저의 수치와 저의 부끄러움을 아십니다. \q 주님 앞에 제 모든 대적이 [있습니다].
ko.B: 주님께서는 제가 받는 비웃음과 수치와 모욕을 아십니다. \q 제 원수들이 하나도 빠짐없이 주님 눈앞에 있습니다.
ko.R: 그들이 저를 얼마나 모욕하고 창피를 주고 우습게 만드는지 주님께서는 아십니다. \q 주님께서는 제 원수들을 다 보십니다.

decisions.choice: you know: an appeal to what God sees
decisions.reason: Nothing has to be explained: God sees the shame and every enemy (verse 6).

decisions.choice: before you: in your sight
decisions.reason: His enemies are all before God's eyes, known to him.

source.text: חֶרְפָּ֤ה׀שָֽׁבְרָ֥ה לִבִּ֗י וָֽאָ֫נ֥וּשָׁה וָאֲקַוֶּ֣ה לָנ֣וּד וָאַ֑יִן וְ֝לַמְנַחֲמִ֗ים וְלֹ֣א מָצָֽאתִי׃

records.literal_gloss: Reproach has broken my heart, and I am sick; and I waited for sympathy, and there was none, and for comforters, and I did not find [any].

en.L: Reproach has broken my heart, and I am sick; \q and I waited for sympathy, but there was none, \q and for comforters, but I did not find [any].
en.B: Scorn has broken my heart, leaving me sick; \q I hoped someone would pity me, but no one did, \q that someone would comfort me, but there was no one to be found.
en.R: Their insults have broken my heart. I feel sick. \q I hoped someone would feel sorry for me, but no one did. \q I looked for someone to comfort me, but I found no one.

fr.L: L’insulte a brisé mon cœur, et je suis malade ; \q et j’ai attendu de la pitié, mais il n’y en a pas eu, \q et des consolateurs, mais je n’[en] ai pas trouvé.
fr.B: Le mépris m’a brisé le cœur, et j’en suis malade ; \q j’espérais que quelqu’un aurait pitié, mais personne, \q que quelqu’un me consolerait, mais je n’ai trouvé personne.
fr.R: Leurs insultes m’ont brisé le cœur. Je me sens malade. \q J’espérais que quelqu’un me plaindrait, mais personne ne l’a fait. \q J’ai cherché quelqu’un pour me consoler, mais je n’ai trouvé personne.

sw.L: Aibu imevunja moyo wangu, nami ni mgonjwa; \q nikangojea mtu wa kunihurumia, lakini hakuwepo, \q na wafariji, lakini sikumpata [yeyote].
sw.B: Dharau imeuvunja moyo wangu, ikaniacha mgonjwa; \q nilitumaini mtu angenionea huruma, lakini hakuna aliyefanya hivyo, \q kwamba mtu angenifariji, lakini hakuonekana yeyote.
sw.R: Matusi yao yamevunja moyo wangu. Ninajisikia mgonjwa. \q Nilitumaini mtu angenionea huruma, lakini hakuna. \q Nilitafuta mtu wa kunifariji, lakini sikumpata yeyote.

es.L: La afrenta ha quebrantado mi corazón, y estoy enfermo; \q y esperé compasión, pero no la hubo, \q y consoladores, pero no [los] hallé.
es.B: El desprecio me ha roto el corazón y me ha dejado enfermo; \q esperé que alguien se compadeciera de mí, pero nadie lo hizo, \q que alguien me consolara, pero no encontré a nadie.
es.R: Sus insultos me han roto el corazón. Me siento enfermo. \q Esperaba que alguien sintiera lástima por mí, pero nadie lo hizo. \q Busqué a alguien que me consolara, pero no encontré a nadie.

vi.L: Sự sỉ nhục đã làm tan nát lòng tôi, và tôi đau yếu; \q và tôi đã trông đợi sự cảm thông, nhưng chẳng có, \q và [trông đợi] những người an ủi, nhưng tôi chẳng tìm thấy [ai].
vi.B: Sự khinh miệt đã làm tan nát lòng tôi, khiến tôi đau ốm; \q tôi mong có người thương xót, nhưng chẳng có ai, \q mong có người an ủi, nhưng chẳng tìm được một người nào.
vi.R: Những lời sỉ nhục của chúng làm tan nát lòng tôi. Tôi thấy đau yếu. \q Tôi mong có ai đó thương hại tôi, nhưng chẳng có ai. \q Tôi tìm người an ủi tôi, nhưng không tìm thấy ai cả.

ko.L: 모욕이 제 마음을 부수어서 제가 병들었습니다. \q 제가 동정을 기다렸으나 없었고, \q 위로하는 자들을 [기다렸으나] 찾지 못했습니다.
ko.B: 비웃음이 제 마음을 무너뜨려 저는 병들었습니다. \q 누가 저를 불쌍히 여겨 주기를 바랐으나 아무도 없었고, \q 누가 저를 위로해 주기를 바랐으나 한 사람도 찾지 못했습니다.
ko.R: 그들의 모욕 때문에 제 마음이 무너졌습니다. 몸까지 아픕니다. \q 누가 저를 가엾게 여겨 주기를 바랐지만 아무도 없었습니다. \q 저를 위로해 줄 사람을 찾았지만 한 사람도 없었습니다.

decisions.choice: I am sick: weak and ill
decisions.reason: The verb (nush) is found only here; it seems to mean to be sick or weak.

decisions.choice: sympathy: shaking the head in pity
decisions.reason: The verb (nud) is to nod or shake the head, the gesture of someone who shares in another's grief (Job 2:11; 42:11).

decisions.choice: no comforters
decisions.reason: Compare Lamentations 1:2, 9: Jerusalem has "no one to comfort her".

source.text: וַיִּתְּנ֣וּ בְּבָרוּתִ֣י רֹ֑אשׁ וְ֝לִצְמָאִ֗י יַשְׁק֥וּנִי חֹֽמֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: And they put in my food poison, and for my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.

en.L: And they put poison in my food, \q and for my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
en.B: They put bitter poison into my food, \q and for my thirst they handed me sour wine.
en.R: They put poison in my food. \q When I was thirsty, they gave me sour wine.

fr.L: Et ils ont mis du poison dans ma nourriture, \q et pour ma soif ils m’ont fait boire du vinaigre.
fr.B: Ils ont mis un poison amer dans ma nourriture, \q et quand j’avais soif, ils m’ont donné du vin aigre.
fr.R: Ils ont mis du poison dans ma nourriture. \q Quand j’avais soif, ils m’ont donné du vin aigre.

sw.L: Nao waliweka sumu katika chakula changu, \q na kwa kiu yangu walininywesha siki.
sw.B: Waliweka sumu chungu katika chakula changu, \q na nilipokuwa na kiu walinipa divai iliyochacha.
sw.R: Waliweka sumu katika chakula changu. \q Nilipokuwa na kiu, walinipa divai iliyochacha.

es.L: Y pusieron veneno en mi comida, \q y para mi sed me dieron a beber vinagre.
es.B: Pusieron veneno amargo en mi comida, \q y para mi sed me ofrecieron vino agrio.
es.R: Pusieron veneno en mi comida. \q Cuando tuve sed, me dieron vino agrio.

vi.L: Và chúng đã bỏ chất độc vào thức ăn của tôi, \q và trong cơn khát của tôi chúng đã cho tôi uống giấm.
vi.B: Chúng bỏ chất độc đắng vào thức ăn của tôi, \q và khi tôi khát, chúng đưa cho tôi rượu chua.
vi.R: Chúng bỏ thuốc độc vào thức ăn của tôi. \q Khi tôi khát, chúng cho tôi uống rượu chua.

ko.L: 그들이 제 음식에 독을 넣었고, \q 제가 목마를 때 그들이 제게 식초를 마시게 했습니다.
ko.B: 그들이 제 음식에 쓴 독을 넣고, \q 목마른 제게 신 포도주를 내밀었습니다.
ko.R: 그들은 제 음식에 독을 넣었습니다. \q 제가 목마를 때 신 포도주를 주었습니다.

decisions.choice: poison: a bitter, poisonous plant
decisions.reason: The word (rosh) is a bitter, poisonous plant, often paired with wormwood (Deuteronomy 29; Lamentations 3:19).

decisions.choice: vinegar: sour wine
decisions.reason: The word (chomets) is wine gone sour; it was a cheap drink, not a kindness to a thirsty man (Proverbs 10:26).

decisions.choice: the cross: gall and sour wine
decisions.reason: At the crucifixion Jesus was offered wine mixed with gall, and then sour wine on a sponge (Matthew 27:34, 48; Mark 15:36; John 19:28-30). The Gospels tell it in words that recall this verse.

decisions.choice: sour wine
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the drink was (m2).

source.text: יְהִֽי־שֻׁלְחָנָ֣ם לִפְנֵיהֶ֣ם לְפָ֑ח וְלִשְׁלוֹמִ֥ים לְמוֹקֵֽשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: Let their table before them become a trap, and for [those at] peace a snare.

en.L: Let their table before them become a trap, \q and for [those at] peace a snare.
en.B: May the meal set before them become a trap for them, \q a snare when they feel secure.
en.R: Let their own feasts become a trap for them. \q When they feel safe, let them be caught.

fr.L: Que leur table devant eux devienne un piège, \q et pour [ceux qui sont en] paix, un filet.
fr.B: Que le repas servi devant eux devienne pour eux un piège, \q un filet au moment où ils se croient en sécurité.
fr.R: Que leurs propres festins deviennent un piège pour eux. \q Quand ils se sentent en sécurité, qu’ils soient pris.

sw.L: Meza yao mbele yao na iwe mtego, \q na kwa [walio na] amani, tanzi.
sw.B: Chakula kilichowekwa mbele yao na kiwe mtego kwao, \q tanzi wakati wanapojiona salama.
sw.R: Karamu zao wenyewe na ziwe mtego kwao. \q Wanapojiona salama, na wanaswe.

es.L: Que su mesa delante de ellos se vuelva una trampa, \q y para [los que están en] paz, un lazo.
es.B: Que el banquete que tienen delante se les convierta en trampa, \q en un lazo cuando se sienten seguros.
es.R: Que sus propias fiestas sean una trampa para ellos. \q Cuando se sientan a salvo, que queden atrapados.

vi.L: Nguyện bàn ăn của chúng trước mặt chúng trở thành cái bẫy, \q và cho [những kẻ đang] bình an [thành] cái lưới.
vi.B: Nguyện bữa ăn dọn ra trước mặt chúng trở thành cái bẫy cho chúng, \q thành cái lưới khi chúng tưởng mình được an ổn.
vi.R: Nguyện chính những bữa tiệc của chúng trở thành cái bẫy cho chúng. \q Khi chúng tưởng mình an toàn, nguyện chúng bị sa bẫy.

ko.L: 그들 앞의 그들의 밥상이 덫이 되게 하시고, \q 평안한 자들에게는 올무가 [되게 하여 주십시오].
ko.B: 그들 앞에 차려진 밥상이 그들에게 덫이 되게 하시고, \q 그들이 마음 놓고 있을 때 올무가 되게 하여 주십시오.
ko.R: 그들의 잔치가 오히려 그들을 잡는 덫이 되게 해 주십시오. \q 그들이 안전하다고 느낄 때 걸려들게 해 주십시오.

decisions.choice: for those at peace: when they feel secure
decisions.reason: The word (shelomim) can mean "those at peace", allies, or the peace offerings eaten at a feast. The ancient Greek translation read it with other vowels as "repayment", and Romans 11:9 follows that reading.

decisions.choice: Romans 11:9-10
decisions.reason: Paul quotes verses 23-24, from the Greek, of those in Israel who did not believe: "Let their table become a snare and a trap, a stumbling block and a retribution for them."

decisions.choice: a prayer for judgment
decisions.reason: Verses 23-29 ask God to punish the enemies. The psalmist does not take revenge himself but hands the case to God, the judge (Romans 12:19). The table that they spread with poison for him (verse 22) is to become their own trap.

source.text: תֶּחְשַׁ֣כְנָה עֵ֭ינֵיהֶם מֵרְא֑וֹת וּ֝מָתְנֵ֗יהֶם תָּמִ֥יד הַמְעַֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: Let their eyes be darkened from seeing, and their loins continually make shake.

en.L: Let their eyes be darkened from seeing, \q and make their loins shake continually.
en.B: May their eyes grow dim until they cannot see; \q make their bodies tremble without end.
